scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory apps/api alembic upgrade head
scripts.seed:mock: uv run --directory apps/api --env-file ../../.env.mock sh -c 'alembic upgrade head && python -m bide_followup.seed --demo --mock'
scripts.gen:types: uv run --directory apps/api python -m bide_followup.openapi ../../packages/shared-types/openapi.json && pnpm --filter @bide-followup/shared-types gen
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @bide-followup/web lint && uv run --directory apps/api ruff check
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck
